question: Identify the group of major Jute producing states of India.

options.text: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Madhya Pradesh

solution:
The Correct Answer is **West Bengal, Bihar, Assam, Odisha**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **major jute-producing states **in India are **West Bengal, Assam, Bihar, Orissa, and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• However, the** Indian jute industry **mainly depends on **West Bengal** due to the higher number of mills.
